from shop.kiosk import kiosk_allows
from shop.policy import booking_allowed, priority, renewal_allowed, standing_allows
from shop.preview import preview_allows


def test_standing_within_grace():
    assert standing_allows(2, False, 10) is True


def test_standing_copies_agree_on_a_late_member():
    assert standing_allows(5, False, 0) is preview_allows(5, False, 0) is kiosk_allows(5, False, 0) is False


def test_suspended_member_is_refused_everywhere():
    assert not standing_allows(0, True, 0) and not preview_allows(0, True, 0) and not kiosk_allows(0, True, 0)


def test_renewal():
    assert renewal_allowed(10) and not renewal_allowed(20)


def test_booking_for_vips():
    assert booking_allowed(30, True) and not booking_allowed(30, False)


def test_priority():
    assert [priority(80, False), priority(30, True), priority(30, False)] == [2, 1, 3]
